changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Outbox transaccional de avisos por correo (ARC-115): solicitud de aviso con contenido congelado, idempotencia por clave de negocio y estado de entrega
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE aviso_correo ( notification_id VARCHAR2(36 CHAR) NOT NULL, notification_key VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) NOT NULL, notification_type VARCHAR2(40 CHAR) NOT NULL, incident_id NUMBER, history_entry_id NUMBER, recipient_user_id NUMBER, recipient_email VARCHAR2(254 CHAR), subject VARCHAR2(255 CHAR), body_text CLOB, body_html CLOB, status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) DEFAULT 'PENDIENTE' NOT NULL, previous_status_code VARCHAR2(20 CHAR), new_status_code VARCHAR2(20 CHAR), suppression_reason_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR), suppressed_at TIMESTAMP(6), attempt_count NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, max_attempts NUMBER DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL, next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP(6), locked_by VARCHAR2(60 CHAR), locked_at TIMESTAMP(6), last_error_code VARCHAR2(50 CHAR), last_error_message VARCHAR2(500 CHAR), message_id VARCHAR2(255 CHAR), sent_at TIMESTAMP(6), resent_by_user_id NUMBER, resent_at TIMESTAMP(6), created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, dispatch_id GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(notification_id AS VARCHAR2(36 CHAR))) VIRTUAL, status_code GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(status AS VARCHAR2(20 CHAR))) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_aviso_correo PRIMARY KEY (notification_id), CONSTRAINT uk_aviso_correo_notif_key UNIQUE (notification_key), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_correo_incidencia FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidencia (incident_id), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_correo_historico FOREIGN KEY (history_entry_id) REFERENCES incidencia_historico (history_id), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_correo_destinatario FOREIGN KEY (recipient_user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_correo_prev_status FOREIGN KEY (previous_status_code) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_correo_new_status FOREIGN KEY (new_status_code) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_aviso_correo_resent_by FOREIGN KEY (resent_by_user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Enumerados y reglas de coherencia del aviso: tipo, estado de entrega, vinculo con la incidencia y su historico, supresion motivada y tope de reintentos
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE aviso_correo ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aviso_correo_supresion CHECK ( (status = 'SUPRIMIDO' AND suppression_reason_code IS NOT NULL AND suppressed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'SUPRIMIDO' AND suppression_reason_code IS NULL AND suppressed_at IS NULL) )

ALTER TABLE aviso_correo ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aviso_correo_vinculo CHECK ( (notification_type = 'NEW_INCIDENT_ALERT' AND incident_id IS NOT NULL AND history_entry_id IS NULL) OR (notification_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE_ALERT' AND incident_id IS NOT NULL AND history_entry_id IS NOT NULL) OR (notification_type IN ('CREDENTIAL_ISSUED','PASSWORD_RESET') AND incident_id IS NULL AND history_entry_id IS NULL AND recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL) )

ALTER TABLE aviso_correo ADD CONSTRAINT ck_aviso_correo_transicion CHECK ( (notification_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE_ALERT' AND previous_status_code IS NOT NULL AND new_status_code IS NOT NULL AND previous_status_code <> new_status_code) OR (notification_type <> 'STATUS_CHANGE_ALERT' AND previous_status_code IS NULL AND new_status_code IS NULL) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Invariantes de unicidad del outbox y acceso FIFO del despachador: un unico aviso de alta por incidencia, un unico aviso por entrada de historico y consumo por estado y fecha de reintento
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_aviso_correo_alta ON aviso_correo (CASE WHEN notification_type = 'NEW_INCIDENT_ALERT' THEN incident_id END)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_aviso_correo_cambio_estado ON aviso_correo (CASE WHEN notification_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE_ALERT' THEN incident_id END, CASE WHEN notification_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE_ALERT' THEN history_entry_id END)
CREATE INDEX ix_aviso_correo_fifo ON aviso_correo (status, next_attempt_at, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_aviso_correo_incidencia ON aviso_correo (incident_id, created_at DESC)

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: REQ-142: ENVIADO es estado terminal, el trigger rechaza con ORA-20060 cualquier transicion que salga de el
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_aviso_correo_estado_final BEFORE UPDATE ON aviso_correo FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.status = 'ENVIADO' AND NEW.status <> 'ENVIADO') BEGIN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20060, 'El aviso ya entregado es terminal: ENVIADO no admite transicion a ' || :NEW.status); END;
